title: Facile Ru-catalysed synthesis of quinazolin-4(3 H )-ones by tandem cyclization of 2-nitrobenzonitrile and alcohol derivatives under air
One-pot CuI/ l -proline-catalysed multicomponent synthesis of pyrido[2′,1′:2,3]imidazo[4,5- c ]quinoline derivatives from 2-(2-bromophenyl)imidazo[1,2- a ]pyridines, NH 3 and DMSO under air
